chapters.title: Merge sort with a separate counting pass

frames.caption: Merge sort with a separate counting pass — O(n log n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: reverse_pairs(nums=[2, 4, 3, 5, 1]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
count, j = cl + cr, 0 — 2 pushed on the front of a; right = [4]; cr = 0; count = 0; …
while j < len(right) and x > 2 * right[j]: → false (j = 0, x = 2)
count, j = cl + cr, 0 — 5 pushed on the front of a; right = [1]; cr = 0; count = 0; …
while j < len(right) and x > 2 * right[j]: → true (j = 0, x = 5)
while j < len(right) and x > 2 * right[j]: → false (j = 1, x = 5)
count, j = cl + cr, 0 — 3 pushed on the front of a; left[0] becomes 3; right gets 5 appended; cr = 1; …
while j < len(right) and x > 2 * right[j]: → true (j = 0, x = 3)
while j < len(right) and x > 2 * right[j]: → false (j = 1, x = 3)
count, j = cl + cr, 0 — a is now [2, 4, 3, 5, 1]; mid = 2; left is now [2, 4]; right is now [1, 3, 5]; …
while j < len(right) and x > 2 * right[j]: → false (j = 0, x = 2)
while j < len(right) and x > 2 * right[j]: → true (j = 0, x = 4)
while j < len(right) and x > 2 * right[j]: → false (j = 1, x = 4)
